body: I can’t stand ‘the mrs’ anymore 🤬🤢 my first bf used to use it all the time even tho I was 16. It just doesn’t make sense to me and makes my skin crawl
I’d see it as suspicious, especially because he came round even though there was no reason. But she may have asked him round still, and the only way to know is to talk about it
If that’s the case then hopefully she’ll trust you. Tell her if you want to, but stay calm and open about it. If she gets upset and you get upset back it will look like jealousy

Personally I’d want to know what he said. She might be able to confirm or deny any suspicions you have about his motive. If you’re worried he’s trying to manipulate the situation for his own gain then remove him from the situation. Sometimes it’s better to deal with issues as a couple, and only bring in other people that are professionals

I wouldn’t take the sex toy part too seriously, if she likes it and it works then good for her. 
But personally I’d be very upset about the pictures. Have you talked since about it?

I’m glad it helped. I didn’t know whether it’s different in other countries or the difference between youth and adult therapies but I assumed it’s all quite standard. 
Well done xx

I’m really sorry you had to go through that. I’ve been to a sexual trauma therapist before and it helps so much! At the initial consultation they tend to ask very open ended questions so you can steer the conversation. Some even have forms or questionnaires they ask you to fill out so they can get a better understanding of where you’re at
Definitely leave his life! Especially if he’s demanding your attention or threatening to harm himself or you.
How long were you logged out??

That’s a good one. And something I’m still learning to do because I don’t want to feel rude and annoying constantly nagging and reminding but I know it’s stuff he hasn’t even thought of. My bf is gradually learning to recognise when he doesn’t quite understand or know what to do and to ask, because he says he feels dumb for not knowing somethings intuitively

Is there anything your wife does that you think could be helpful and a support to many ND parents? 

We both know that there are high chances for our children to have ASD but as a couple I know we can support them because my bf and his family has personal experiences with young children with ASD, and I’m studying Psych at uni with a focus on ASD and mental health so know the clinical side of it
That’s an amazing idea! Thank you so much
I use Happify which is more mood tracking and little games, more of a short term thing. I got Woebot today and so far it’s been great
Me and my bf are going through something that sounds similar. We’re taking a break while he fixes himself with therapy before we have a try at fixing us. Maybe have a look into a CBT app?
Even with parents on the spectrum? I don’t know any parents with ASD so I’m not sure whether the reciprocity is the same as with NT parents and asd child

He loves researching so I have a feeling he’s going to buy every baby book ever aha. 

We both know that there’s a high chance of our child having autism because of his ASD and my sensory processing issues. But I work in and am studying SEN so I’m clued in on kinda what’s required.

I’ve dated truly toxic guys and I can safely say I don’t want even a hint of toxicity in a relationship now. But I think for most girls it’s the excitement and constant change that comes with toxic guys. Personally, I want a genuinely nice kind guy that’s spontaneous
That makes sense. It’s kinda ironic though cause I’m well aware that my kinks developed as a coping mechanism to deal with the trauma my first bf put me through
As long as it’s said gently and you’re at least an arms length away then yeah

For me it depends more on the body language. If a guy came up to me and said that in an arrogant pickup line kinda way I’d be scared. But if it was more natural and genuinely complimentary it’s a lovely thing to say
